[classes: 81e2d7e9] (repository/scripts/benchmark_decision_evidence.py:148-156, repository/scripts/benchmark_decision_evidence.py:290-307, repository/tests/test_decision_benchmark.py:39-56, plan:20-21)

## Risks

Nothing notable.

## Gaps

Nothing notable.

## Improvements

- [MAJOR] Restore all eight archived audits from the original files byte-for-byte, preserving the existing campaign hashes. Check every retained copy against its receipt digest before delivery. No provider rerun or digest redefinition is needed.
- [MAJOR] Record each completed provider reply and its lifecycle before admission. Wrap operational admission exceptions in DeciderAttemptFailure carrying accumulated attempts, keeping them terminal without another provider retry. Add public-handler cases for initial and corrected resolver failures that verify current and prior replies, completed sibling retention, and cleanup.
- [MAJOR] Collect available attempt, result, timing, and workspace records independently of qualification checks. Preserve invalidated records as explicitly unqualified observations with their failure reasons, and represent unavailable timing as unknown. Add report-level tests for post-run source drift, failed-worker markers, and missing workspace observations.
- [MAJOR] Require exact coverage between observed attempt roots and unique complete workspace rows, checking provider and snapshot bindings in both directions. Add a report-level two-round case that removes one workspace row while retaining its provider attempts and requires qualification to fail.
